notablePrerequisites:
Dune-Brood Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Dune-Brood Nephilim.
You control at least six lands.
description:
Deal combat damage with Dune-Brood Nephilim.
Dune-Brood Nephilim triggers, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Proceed to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing five Sand tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase and main phase after this phase.
Repeat.
